messages:
maria_g: FYI — BigBank POC asked for SIEM event stream samples + retention and admin-activity evidence. Can we assemble: (1) NDJSON sample of events, (2) exact retention policy excerpt, (3) admin activity examples (token create/revoke, model deploy, role change), and (4) a tamper-evidence hash for the export?

alex_s: We can. Will provide an ndjson dump + S3 path and a signed SHA256 for the file. Do they want syslog/GELF or cloud-syslog push?

jordan_p: BigBank runs Splunk for ingestion. They asked for both raw NDJSON and a short mapping doc (field -> Splunk/CEF). Also include examples of what our admin events look like (who did what).

maria_g: Perfect — ask: retention window they need to validate is 90 days for hosted by default. Dedicated can be configured longer. Please include the retention config export.

devon_ops: Quick notes on what I'll export: admin_activity, auth_audit, model_deploy, api_token events. Export command (internal CLI):

```
redwood-cli logs export --start 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z --end 2026-10-07T23:59:59Z --types admin_activity,auth_audit,model_deploy,api_token --format ndjson --out /tmp/bigbank_poc_events.ndjson
```

Sample NDJSON lines (anonymized):

```
{"ts":"2026-10-03T14:02:11Z","type":"admin_activity","actor":"sys:admin:maria_g","action":"role.update","target":"user:j.smith","details":{"from":"developer","to":"admin"}}
{"ts":"2026-10-03T14:05:09Z","type":"api_token","actor":"system","action":"token.create","target":"token:svc-batch-123","details":{"scope":"inference:invoke","created_by":"maria_g"}}
{"ts":"2026-10-04T09:33:42Z","type":"model_deploy","actor":"jordan_p","action":"deploy.start","target":"model:redwood-7b:v3","details":{"env":"dedicated-gpu-1","deploy_id":"dpl-98a7"}}
{"ts":"2026-10-04T09:34:55Z","type":"auth_audit","actor":"auth:oauth","action":"login.failure","target":"user:j.smith","details":{"reason":"mfa_required"}}
```

These are representative; full export will include tiebreaker fields (request_id, ip, region).

alex_s: For retention: hosted default 90 days (retention_days=90). Dedicated customers can request custom retention; enterprise package supports archival to customer S3 for N years. I'll attach the config snippet we export for POC validation.

devon_ops: Retention config export (example JSON) I will include in the bundle. Example line: `retention_policy":{"default_days":90,"max_supported_days":3650,"archival":"s3://redwood-archives/bigbank/"}`

secbot: SIG/CAIQ mapping generated: controls related to "Logging and Monitoring" -> CAIQ CCM 4.0 mappings attached. Export package will include a small mapping CSV: control_id, redwood_event_type, example_event_id.

ellen_security: For tamper evidence, we produce: (1) canonical NDJSON export, (2) SHA256 hash of the full file, (3) timestamped signature using our internal key. We can also provide an HMAC keyed to customer-provided KMS if BigBank wants direct verification.

maria_g: Good. Can you also highlight admin UI actions vs API actions so they can verify separation of privilege?

jordan_p: Will mark events with "actor_source":"ui|api|system" and include a short legend. Example: actor_source=ui for Console role changes, api for CLI/SDK, system for automated rotation.

alex_s: ETA: I'll bundle artifacts (ndjson sample, mapping CSV, retention excerpt, sha256.txt, signature.asc, README.md) and upload to a pre-signed s3 link by EOD 2026-10-07.

maria_g: Thanks — please ping @bigbank-sales when done and include the Splunk ingest example (props: sourcetype, timestamp parsing).

devon_ops: Splunk ingest snippet I'll include:

```
# example HTTP Event Collector payload
curl -k -H "Authorization: Splunk <token>" https://splunk.example/services/collector/event -d '{"event": {"ts":"2026-10-03T14:02:11Z","type":"admin_activity","actor":"maria_g","action":"role.update"}}'
```

secbot: Added: note about privacy — PII redaction applied in POC exports. We remove full email addresses and IP truncation to /24 unless customer approves full fidelity.

maria_g: Awesome. Final ask: include a very short one-page cover (single markdown) that states scope of data, time range, redaction rules, and contact for contested events. Then I'll forward to BigBank.

alex_s: Will do. I'll post the presigned link in this thread once uploaded. :thumbsup:

maria_g: Thanks all!
